title: mail: Config struct (TOML)
description:
Define Config in crates/mail/src/config.rs: [listen] addr, [tls] cert_path/key_path, [database] path, [auth] required/users (same pattern as reader). Add Config::from_file(), Config::validate(). Add [log] level/format.

Why: config must be designed before the HTTP server or DB layer can be wired.

Acceptance: cargo test -p usenet-ipfs-mail; config round-trip test parses a minimal TOML string.
